Lua 5.4.9 (2026-08-10), MIT license.

Unmodified .c/.h sources from https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz
SHA-256: 2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6

Built as C++ with exceptions for safe unwinding through the mission builder. Only the core, auxiliary and base libraries are linked; no Lua DLL is required. No interpreter/compiler entry points or I/O, OS, package, debug, coroutine, string, math or table libraries are linked. See src/lua.h for the full license notice.
